project: Firmware Rewrite - Delta: Serial Commands & Test Engine
description: Implement serial command interface and BCODE test execution engine. Serial commands provide diagnostics and manual control. BCODE interpreter executes test scripts.

bcodeCommands.15: Take sensor readings(channel, gain, step, integration)
bcodeCommands.16: Continuous sensor readings(baseline, position, distance, step_delay)
